axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:d4a1571.title: Growth
axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:d4a1571.description: ABOUT US At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here https://www.axle.energy/blog/analysis/power-of-the-home. THIS ROLE IS FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN DRIVE GO-TO-MARKET SUCCESS AND BUILD A REPEATABLE COMMERCIAL MOTION AS AXLE GROWS. You’ll help customers adopt our technology, commercialise flexibility across their customer base, and expand usage over time. You’ll be expected to move quickly, remove friction, and adapt processes pragmatically rather than getting stuck in bureaucracy. We’re looking for someone with strong commercial instincts, a sharp GTM mindset, and the ability to operate comfortably in technical conversations. THIS ROLE WILL OWN: - Winning new business - Developing and managing our growing sales pipeline - Go-to-market strategy and execution - Client onboarding and ongoing commercial relationship management WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - Defining sales at Axle, as we establish our go-to-market approach. You will have the ability to make an immediate contribution to our rapidly increasing revenue growth - Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue (bonus points if you can do this in multiple languages) - Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing considerations, customer segmentation, and launch strategies - Acting as a commercial bridge between partners and internal teams, translating market and customer insights into clear product, pricing, and GTM inputs - Building and refine scalable sales and partner processes that support repeatable growth across different customer segments - Tracking performance, pipeline, and outcomes, using data to prioritise effort and continuously improve commercial effectiveness BENEFITS A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. INTERVIEW PROCESS 1. Initial interview 2. Take-home exercise 3. Final interview (in-person) 4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. jobgether-jobgether:lever:604c7d06-17ba-.title: Senior Accounts Receivable & Revenue Operations Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:604c7d06-17ba-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accounts Receivable & Revenue Operations Specialist based in United Kingdom. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical revenue operations within a fast-paced, remote startup environment. You will manage the revenue cycle end-to-end, ensuring accuracy and efficiency from quoting through collections. The position combines accounts receivable expertise with systems optimization, reporting, automation, and process improvement. You will work closely with accounting, sales, and customers to resolve billing issues and maintain strong financial operations. Your ability to identify discrepancies, improve workflows, and strengthen financial controls will directly support business growth. The role is ideal for a proactive finance professional who enjoys autonomy, problem-solving, and evolving priorities. You will have the opportunity to contribute to scalable processes while working with modern accounting and payment technologies. Lead end-to-end revenue operations, covering quote generation, invoicing, reconciliation, receivables tracking, and timely collections. Review invoices and billing information against order forms, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate resolutions with sales teams and customers. Respond to customer and sales inquiries regarding invoices, billing issues, and payment status while taking ownership of the collections process. Support accurate revenue reporting by collaborating with accounting teams and reviewing SQL query outputs for accuracy and consistency. Manage and optimize financial systems such as QuickBooks Online and Stripe, including system upgrades, automation initiatives, and workflow improvements. Identify opportunities to streamline revenue processes, strengthen operational controls, and improve the overall quote-to-cash cycle. Communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders regarding billing, collections, and financial matters. Work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with accounting, sales, and other operational teams. Requirements 2+ years of accounting experience within U.S.-based companies, with a strong focus on Accounts Receivable and Revenue Operations. Demonstrated experience managing the complete revenue cycle from quote to cash. Advanced proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Stripe, with the ability to review SQL query outputs and identify potential inaccuracies. Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills, including the confidence to challenge discrepancies and push back appropriately with customers or sales teams. Experience implementing process improvements, system upgrades, and automation projects within accounting or revenue operations. Familiarity with startup accounting environments and the ability to adapt effectively to changing priorities. Experience with tools such as Slack, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Mercury, Chase, Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or ClickUp is a plus. Professional fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and trustworthy, with a strong sense of ownership and integrity. Comfortable working independently while also contributing effectively within a collaborative team. Coachable and eager to continuously improve processes, systems, and professional capabilities. General awareness of how AI is being applied to accounting and operational workflows is an advantage. Benefits Competitive salary paid in USD per month, based on experience. Unlimited paid vacation days per year. All U.S. national holidays included. Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. Opportunity to work in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities. Professional growth and learning opportunities. Supportive and collaborative working environment. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The News Services department is responsible for tracking all The Madison Square Garden Company’s media presence in media publications, social media news outlets, broadcast, and radio both within the tri state area, and relevant markets (Las Vegas, LA, Chicago, Boston, etc.). The Analyst News Services is responsible for monitoring the designated media publications (both print and online), broadcast and radio shows for any MSG or MSG related mentions that occur.
